```{r}

dir.create('/users/k1806347/oliverpainfel/Analyses/metabolic/config/', recursive = T)

library(data.table)

####
# Create gwas_list
####

gwas_list <- NULL

gwas_list <- rbind(
  gwas_list,
  data.table(
    name = 'MILEAGE01',
    path = '/scratch/prj/ukbiobank/metabolomic/MILEAGE01.txt.gz',
    population = 'EUR',
    n = NA,
    sampling = NA,
    prevalence = NA,
    mean = NA,
    sd = NA,
    label = 'MILEAGE01'))

gwas_list <- rbind(
  gwas_list,
  data.table(
    name = 'MORT01',
    path = '/scratch/prj/ukbiobank/metabolomic/MORT01.txt.gz',
    population = 'EUR',
    n = NA,
    sampling = NA,
    prevalence = NA,
    mean = NA,
    sd = NA,
    label = 'MORT01'))

gwas_list <- rbind(
  gwas_list,
  data.table(
    name = 'PACNI',
    path = '/scratch/prj/ukbiobank/metabolomic/PACNI.txt.gz',
    population = 'EUR',
    n = NA,
    sampling = NA,
    prevalence = NA,
    mean = NA,
    sd = NA,

write.table(gwas_list, '/users/k1806347/oliverpainfel/Analyses/metabolic/config/gwas_list.txt', row.names = F)

####
# Create config file
####

config <- c(
```
